Title: Tab Renders and DataTable Loads
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. Open location 1604 in Navigator
2. Click the "Location Management History" tab
3. Observe the DataTable
Expected Result: DataTable is visible with column headers. No spinner remains after load

Title: All 87 Column Headers Present
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. With "Location Management History" tab active, inspect the table header row
2. Verify first column header is "Local Office"
3. Verify last column header is "Warehouse Billing"
4. Verify column #28 renders an untranslated key
Expected Result: 87 total column headers. Column #28 displays raw i18n key. All other headers display human-readable labels

Title: Default Rows Per Page Is 20
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. With "Location Management History" tab active, locate the "rows per page" control at the bottom of the table
2. Read the current value without opening the dropdown
Expected Result:
Default rows per page = 20.
"Note": Requirements documented 10 as default - live confirmed 20. Requirements discrepancy captured

Title: Rows Per Page Dropdown Options
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. With "Location Management History" tab active, click the "rows per page" dropdown
2. Read all available options

Title: Change Rows Per Page Updates Table Display
Preconditions: Location with at least 11 history rows is open on "Location Management History" tab; rows per page is currently 20
Steps:
1. Click the "rows per page" dropdown
2. Select "10" from the list
3. Observe the table body
Expected Result: Table limits display to 10 rows. Page indicator updates accordingly (e.g., "1 / N" where N > 1)
Notes: CLEANUP: After test, reset rows per page back to 20

Title: Pagination Controls Disabled When Only One Page
Preconditions: Location 1604 is open on "Location Management History" tab; result is 1 row (1 page)
Steps:
1. Observe the "Go to first page" button
2. Observe the "Go to previous page" button
3. Observe the "Go to next page" button
4. Observe the "Go to last page" button
5. Observe the page indicator
Expected Result: All 4 pagination buttons are disabled when only 1 page of results exists

Title: Empty State Message for Location with No History
Preconditions: A location with no management history change records is open on "Location Management History" tab
Steps:
1. Open a location known to have no history records
2. Click the "Location Management History" tab
3. Observe the table body
4. Read the empty state message
Expected Result:
Empty state text "No results." appears in the table body. No data rows. Pagination shows "0 / 0" or "1 / 0".
"Note": Location 1604 had 1 row at time of live verification (2026-02-19). Use a different location with confirmed no history, or check a freshly created location

Title: Data Row Renders with Correct Values (Location 1604)
Preconditions: Location 1604 open on "Location Management History" tab; at least 1 row exists
Steps:
1. Inspect row 1 cell under "Local Office"
2. Inspect row 1 cell under "Local Office Name"
3. Inspect row 1 cell under "Active"
4. Inspect row 1 cell under "Country"
5. Inspect row 1 cell under "Currency"
6. Inspect row 1 cell under "Modified By"
7. Inspect row 1 cell under "Oracle Product Code"
Expected Result: All verified cells match expected values. Checkmark columns show -> for active boolean fields

Title: Sort Ascending on Sortable Column
Preconditions: Location with multiple history rows open on "Location Management History" tab
Steps:
1. Locate the "Modified On" column header - confirm it has a sort button
2. Click the "Modified On" column header
3. Inspect first and last visible rows
Expected Result: Modified On column sorts ascending. Sort icon updates to indicate ascending order. Row order changes accordingly

Title: Sort Descending by Toggling Same Column
Preconditions: Table is sorted ascending on "Modified On" (from TC-LOC-MGH-009)
Steps:
1. Click the "Modified On" column header a second time
2. Inspect first and last visible rows
Expected Result: Clicking the active sort column again reverses to descending. Sort icon reflects descending state

Title: Sort by Live Date Column
Preconditions: Location with multiple history rows open on "Location Management History" tab
Steps:
1. Locate the "Live Date" column header - confirm sort button is present
2. Click the "Live Date" column header
3. Verify first row has earliest Live Date value
Expected Result: Table reorders rows by Live Date ascending. Sort button on Live Date shows active sort indicator

Title: Non-Sortable Columns Have No Sort Button
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. Locate the "Active" column header
2. Locate the "Corporate Pricing" column header
3. Locate the "Allow DPCD" column header
4. Locate the "Warehouse Billing" column header (last column)
Expected Result: Non-sortable columns have static header text only - no sort button, no sort icon, no click affordance

Title: Untranslated i18n Key in Column 28 (Bug)
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active. "LDW Percentage" field shows default value (0.04)
Steps:
1. With "Location Management History" tab active, scroll right to locate column #28 (after "LDW Percentage")
2. Read the column header text
Expected Result: Column #28 renders the untranslated i18n key locations.history.CalcDamageWaiverOnNetAmount - known bug. Human-readable header ("Calculate LDW on Net Amount" or equivalent) should appear instead

Title: Duplicate "Calculate CAC on Net Amount" Column Headers (Bug)
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. Scroll the table to find columns "#37" and "#38" (after "Apply Cables and Consumables Fee" and "C&C Percent")
2. Read both column header labels
3. Verify sort availability
Expected Result: Columns #37 and #38 both display "Calculate CAC on Net Amount" as their header - known label defect. Column #37 has no sort button; column #38 has a sort button. Headers should be distinct

Title: Read-Only - No Add/Edit/Delete Controls Present
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. With "Location Management History" tab active, inspect the area above/below the table
2. Inspect each visible data row
3. Inspect the tab panel
Expected Result: Zero Add, Edit, Delete, or Save controls are present in the Location Management History tabpanel. The tab is entirely read-only

Title: Read-Only - Table Cells Are Not Interactive
Preconditions: Location 1604 open on "Location Management History" tab; at least 1 data row visible
Steps:
1. Click on any cell value in the data row (e.g., "Local Office Name" cell)
2. Attempt to double-click on the cell
3. Observe the cursor and focus behaviour
Expected Result: Cells are non-interactive. Clicks do not trigger editing. No form controls appear

Title: Horizontal Scroll Works for Wide Table
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. With "Location Management History" tab active, observe the initial table view
2. Scroll right inside the table container
3. Continue scrolling to the rightmost column
Expected Result: Table scrolls horizontally. All 87 columns are accessible via horizontal scroll. Column headers stay sticky (if applicable) or scroll with data

Title: API Endpoint Called on Tab Activation
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Location Management History tab is active
Steps:
1. Open location 1604 on "Basic Information" tab
2. Open browser DevTools Network panel and filter to history
3. Click the "Location Management History" tab
4. Inspect network requests
Expected Result: Exactly one API call to /api/location/{locationNo}/history?IsCorporate=true is triggered on tab activation. Response returns HTTP 200 with a data array

Title: Pagination Navigation Enables with Multiple Pages
Preconditions: A location with more than 20 history rows is open on "Location Management History" tab; rows per page = 20
Steps:
1. Observe the page indicator
2. Observe the "Go to first page" and "Go to previous page" buttons
3. Observe the "Go to next page" and "Go to last page" buttons
4. Click "Go to next page"
5. Click "Go to previous page"
6. Click "Go to last page"
7. Click "Go to first page"
Expected Result: Pagination navigation works correctly. Forward/back buttons enable/disable based on current page position. Page indicator always reflects current position accurately
